summary: Hardened wrapper-side safety for interrupted runs and lost inotify events while keeping nextcloudcmd as the sole synchronization engine.
changelog: Detects Linux IN_Q_OVERFLOW explicitly instead of silently discarding the special inotify event.
Rebuilds filesystem monitoring after an inotify overflow and requests one protected reconciliation through nextcloudcmd; PyNextCloud Sync does not implement its own rescan or synchronization engine.
Adds a tiny durable run marker immediately before nextcloudcmd starts and removes it only after a successful run has produced a committed safety baseline.

After an interrupted wrapper run, validates the existing last-known-good baseline before recovery, preserving the existing folder identity, empty-tree, missing-database, and mass-deletion protections.
Keeps the run marker when the post-sync safety baseline cannot be persisted, so an uncommitted wrapper run is not silently treated as fully recorded.
